label: Instamojo
reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25: the public Instamojo API v2 reference index (https://docs.instamojo.com/llms.txt) still lists only the payment-gateway calls - client-credentials token (generate-access-token-application-based-authentication), create / get a payment request, create an order for the SDK, get payment details, create a refund, get a refund - with no product or listing endpoint, no list of payments or payment requests, no account endpoint for a probe and no totals. The marketplace verbs (list_products, get_product, create_product, update_price, list_sales, get_sales_stats, list_refunds) have nothing to map; a server exposing only the money-moving refund call (by payment id the model could not look up) is not provided.
